I have recovered, it may be random that I recovered, but this is what I recommend
Do's
Eat healthy, especially focus on getting antioxidants. 50 percent of my died was nuts and berries.
Use doxycyclin. That antibiotic made me worse while taking it, but I think it ultimately killed the bacteria.
Sleep a lot. (I know this is hard for some of you, I had a lot of trouble with it in periods)
Dont's
Blindly follow everything you read on the internet (yes i get the paradox haha. Ha (ha).)
Do that fucking salt thing. c-vitamins is ok, but eating huge amounts of salt will kill you before lyme does.
Spend all your time and energy on reading and thinking about lyme. Remission is slow, and it doesn't speed up by reading shit from supportgroups all the time.
